_comment: RHINO v1.0 ESCALATION book — stress-gated crisis-convexity leg of the crisis-alpha fund. DORMANT in calm: each tick the shared STRESS detector tallies cross-asset stress probes (oil breaking up + equities breaking down + gold bid + BTC rolling over) plus a BTC vol-expansion flag; only when the count clears stressThreshold does the book deploy. It then goes LONG the spiking crisis complex (crisisLongs) and SHORT the cratering risk complex (riskAssets), each scored 4h backbone + 1h confirm + momentum + RSI room. LARGER margin_pct (22%) — the convex add. Moderate-tight DSL banks the spike (crises reverse violently). Leverage clamped to maxLeverage then each asset's HL venue max. Pairs with the HEDGE book (rhino-hedge-config.json) on a SEPARATE wallet. Set wallet/strategyId/chatId. Runtime owns position tracking, caps, cooldowns, DSL via runtime-escalation.yaml. Producer launched with RHINO_LEG=escalation.
_persona: Crisis convexity — dormant in calm (dry powder), fires hard under a confirmed stress regime: LONG spiking crisis assets + SHORT cratering risk. Larger size, moderate-tight DSL that banks the spike. stressThreshold = number of cross-asset stress probes (oil/equities/gold/btc/vol) that must fire to deploy.
